subject: Initial phone screen — availability & timezone (Anika Rao)

Subject: Initial phone screen — availability & timezone (Anika Rao)

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for your interest in the Software Engineer role at Redwood. I’d love to set up a quick 25-minute phone screen so we can learn more about your background and answer any questions you have about the team.

I’m in PDT (UTC-7) — would any of these windows work for you? I included local conversions below to make it easier. If none work, reply with 2–3 times that do.

- Wed Oct 21 — 9:00–9:30 AM PDT (Wed 9:30–10:00 PM IST)
- Wed Oct 21 — 12:00–12:25 PM PDT (Wed 12:30–12:55 AM IST, Thu)
- Thu Oct 22 — 8:30–8:55 AM PDT (Thu 9:00–9:25 PM IST)

Please let me know which slot you prefer (or propose alternatives). I’ll send a calendar invite and include Marissa from Recruiting on the thread.

Attachments: redwood_intro.ics (stub) — this has our interview boilerplate and a short link to our recruiter packet.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sourcing & Recruiting Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
